description: This file defines the CountryDao class that interacts with the database to perform CRUD operations related to Country and Province entities within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The class includes methods for fetching lists of countries and provinces, as well as specific entries based on various identifiers like country code, country name, province code, and province name.

classes.name: CountryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling database operations related to countries and provinces within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all countries ordered by name.

methods.name: getProvinceList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of provinces, optionally filtered by a country code.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryName
methods.description: Fetches a country entity matching the specified country name.

methods.name: getCountryByCountryCode
methods.description: Fetches a country entity matching the specified country code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceCode
methods.description: Retrieves a province entity based on its unique code.

methods.name: getProvinceByProvinceName
methods.description: Retrieves a province entity based on its name.
